title: Chapter 240 Beat Him Up First
content:
Chapter 240 Beat Him Up First

Also, what kind of elixir?

Qin Feng looked at Lu Xue and the others beside Jordanyang, and immediately understood that something must have happened when he was not here just now.

At this time, Xiao Luo looked at Qin Feng and asked, "Brother Qin, why did you come out too? Could it be that because of me, the alchemy will not tolerate you?"

Hearing this, Qin Feng shook his head slightly.

"That's not the case. I'll ask you two to go to this alchemy. If you both leave, how can I stay alone?"

However, it can be seen from the naked eye that Qin Feng still looked a little dejected.

Seeing this, Jordan Yang on the side suddenly laughed: "Why am I? Isn't it just a elixir?"

"I advise you boy, just practice swordsmanship."

Hearing this, Qin Feng touched his head, not knowing what to say, so he had to smile awkwardly.

"Okay, if nothing happens, I will leave first."

As he said that, Jordanyang was about to peel off his feet.

But at this time, Xiao Luo suddenly called Jordanyang.

"Master Qiao!"

"Um?"

Jordanyang frowned slightly and turned his head to look at Xiao Luo.

"Is there anything else you have to do?"

Xiao Luo rubbed his hands and said with a smirk: "That, Master Qiao, my elixir,,,,"

Hearing this, Jordan Yang was slightly stunned, and suddenly remembered that he swallowed Xiao Luo's pill in a mouthful of anxiety.

For a moment, Jordan Yang suddenly looked a little uncomfortable.

It's really embarrassing to steal the younger generation's pills.

But even I don’t have that kind of elixir.

If you spend money to buy it, it will be even more unrealistic.

After pondering for a moment, Jordan Yang said, "Let's do this, I owe you a favor, how about it?"

Hearing this, Xiao Luo was not stupid either, so he nodded and agreed.

Jordanyang's identity and status, looking at the entire fairyland, it is a top-notch existence.

It is conceivable how precious a favor is.

However, he still felt a little distressed about the pill that Lu Xue gave him.

I can't even bear to eat it myself.

It's gone like that.

When Jordanyang saw Xiao Luo nodding, he didn't say anything else, and directly broke through the void and left here.

Judging from the direction of his departure, it seems to be the Wood Fairy Realm.

Standing there, Qin Feng was still in a state of confusion.

Pills, favors?

Master Qiao actually owed Xiao Luo a favor.

"Brother Xiao, no, Brother Xiao, you are my brother!!"

Xiao Luo smiled awkwardly and said nothing.

At this moment, he was obviously still immersed in the sadness of losing the pill just now.

At this time, Lu Xue, who was beside him, glanced at him and then stepped forward and patted Xiao Luo on the shoulder and said, "Okay, isn't it just a pill? I'll give it to you again."

As soon as these words came out, Xiao Luo was shocked.

"Sister Lu, is it true?!"

Lu Xue nodded.

"When did I say big talk?"

Immediately, Lu Xue took out a big bag and stuffed it directly into Xiao Luo's arms.

Looking at the big bag in his arms, Xiao Luo's whole body was trembling slightly.

At this moment, he had a very realistic guess.

This big bag won't be all,

Xiao Luo was trembling and slowly opened the cloth bag in his hand. The purpose was like a pearl, full of elixirs.

It is estimated that there are hundreds of them.

"This, this, this, am I dreaming?"

Looking at Xiao Luo's appearance that he had never seen the world before, Lu Xue sighed slightly.

I can use this kind of elixir as a meal, and I can't finish it.

But she rarely takes pills on weekdays.

Because Lu Daosheng told her that medicine is three parts poisonous, and in terms of cultivation, one still needs to rely on one's own ability.

The cultivation level that comes from the pile of medicine is not useful.

So this pill is given.

On the side, Qin Feng instantly understood as Xiao Luo holding a large bag of elixirs.

Then, a deep envy ejaculation erupted from Qin Feng's eyes.

At this time, Xiao Luo suddenly cried.

Tears kept falling from the corners of his eyes. Xiao Luo cried and knelt down directly at Lu Xue.

"Sister Lu, from now on, Xiao Luo is willing to work hard for you."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's mouth twitched slightly.

As for it?

"Well, that, sister Lu, I,"

Qin Feng, who was beside him, could no longer bear it and hurried forward.

Looking at Qin Feng with hope, Lu Xue looked at Qin Feng, and was silent for a moment, but threw a small bag of elixirs to Qin Feng.

"For the sake of not staying in that alchemy, I'll reward you."

Hearing this, he looked at the pill in his hand again.

Qin Feng's blood was boiling.

Is this the feeling of being kept?

Damn, it's so fucking fun.

"Sister Lu, you are my god!"

At the same time, the distant Wood Fairy World.

In the deserted city.

"Alchemy club, alchemist, haha, interesting."

Lu Daosheng lay on the rocking chair, shaking leisurely while listening to the news brought back from the fairyland by his subordinates in front of him.

Although he said that he ignored Lu Xue.

But after returning to the deserted city, Lu Daosheng immediately sent the people he trained under his command to secretly observe Lu Xue in the Immortal Realm.

Any movements you have, you will report to yourself.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng already knew what happened to Lu Xue at the Alchemy Conference in Tiandi Academy and what Jordanyang was doing.

He couldn't bear it if his daughter was refining alchemy.

Then Lu Daosheng stood up and waved to his subordinates in front of him.

The phantom nodded and disappeared in an instant.

"Oh, I haven't had an activity for a long time."

At this moment, the deserted city has entered a period of slow development.

The entire Wood Fairy Realm, driven by the deserted city, also began to improve continuously.

Now, Huangcheng is well deserved as the leader of the Wood Fairy World.

"Anhui Feng."

Lu Daosheng spoke.

The next moment, Wan Feng's figure appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Master, come to me."

Lu Daosheng nodded.

"I'll go out, you can stare at Huangcheng."

Upon hearing this, Wan Feng smiled and said, "Don't worry, Master, with me here, there will be no accident in the deserted city."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng also smiled, as if he had thought of something. Lu Daosheng continued, "By the way, if an old man who calls himself an alchemist in the Immortal Realm comes to me, don't talk nonsense, beat him first. Let's talk about it again."

After long-term recovery and the extremely rich resources of the deserted city, Wanfeng is no longer the same state that had just broken out.

Now, looking at the entire fairy world, Anfeng is not afraid of anyone except the deserted city.

Although Wan Feng did not understand the cause and effect, he still agreed directly.

"Good master."

"Well, that's it."

After saying that, Lu Daosheng trembled and left the wasteland city directly.

Somewhere in the void.

Lu Daosheng's figure appeared here.

"Alchemist?"

Lu Daosheng murmured to himself.

All his pills were purchased from the system store for zero yuan.

He has never learned alchemy.

Although there is definitely no problem when you learn it yourself, can you still need to refine alchemy with your own identity and strength?
